the screen: x 35, y 116, 124 × 166 px.

## How it was made

Standard v1 ([docs/PIPELINE.md](../../../docs/PIPELINE.md)): measured to scale, re-rendered straight
and clean from a photo, every printed label checked.
Body aspect 0.5203 (spec 0.5143), screen at the exact 240:320 aspect.

**Credits:** appearance from a [photo](https://www.esato.com/gfx/phones/sonyericssonm600.jpg (frontal press render, white margin added)); geometry measured on a [photo](https://www.esato.com/gfx/phones/sonyericssonm600.jpg); specs: [gsmarena.com](https://www.gsmarena.com/sony_ericsson_m600-1425.php), [teltarif.de](https://www.teltarif.de/h/sony-ericsson/m600i/).
